about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in a rich narrative, with meticulously detailed environments, horrific monsters, intricate, challenging puzzles and slow-burn psychological horror inspired by the classics. 

GAMEPLAY

Play as Lucas Hale, a retired police officer, as you find yourself picking up a paranormal investigation job. You've been told to explore the house of the missing CEO of PUPPETEERS Playplace, James Anderson. But when you step in to what used to be his house, you realize it is not what you signed up for.

A fresh take on psychological horror. Forget a fetch quest filled P.T. clone. ENTWINE will keep you on the edge of your seat throughout your entire playthrough.

Solve various puzzles, explore through a forest, house, underground complex, police station and more. Slowly uncover the heartwrenching story behind Lucas Hale and dive deeper into the abandoned estate before being hunted down by the puppet himself.

FEATURES

  • Breathtaking visuals.

  • High-quality, binaural sound powered by Steam Audio.

  • A terrifyingly heavy and fresh take on psychological horror.

  • Varied locations. Explore a forest, abandoned house, police station and more.

  • Pure isolation - no distracting NPCS or gimmicks. Just you and it.

  • Heavy focus on narrative.

  • Challenging and intricate puzzles - Inspired by Silent Hill

  • Native controller / gamepad support.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains realistic depictions of violence and themes involving suicide, self harm and substance abuse.

name: ENTWINE

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 or New-Gen i3 or the AMD equivalent.
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or the AMD equivalent.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 or New-Gen i3 or the AMD equivalent.
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or the AMD equivalent.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space

short_description: ENTWINE is a terrifying first person psychological horror game. Explore horrifically detailed environments in a hand-crafted, story-driven campaign as you uncover the story of Lucas Hale. Run. Hide. But try not to scream, it might hear you.
supported_languages:
English*, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Russian, French, German, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
